rows.what_the_ink_shows: The opening paragraph explicitly says that atelier will henceforth be used where magasin was used, and conversely. It then changes Mag 1 through Mag 4 to At 1 through At 4. The later paragraph explicitly stops using M and uses A for the atelier, followed by the structure tuple. All of these changes are already represented in the original LaTeX. Viewed crops/156-9_scan041_L1098.jpg [243,110,1633,451] and crops/156-9_scan041_L1098_notation.jpg [280,1193,1595,1606], enlarged to 3200 pixels with contrast 1.6.
rows.note: This row records an intentional terminological reversal, already faithfully transcribed, rather than a local misreading to repair. The editorial glossary warning is useful background: from this statement onward atelier and magasin exchange their former uses, and Mag axioms are renamed At axioms. Preserve the existing unrelated doubts about accents, punctuation and A's style. The row's references to diagrams on scans 2–4 were not consulted.
